On a pleasant watch, rules for the kennel crew
This section explains the steps for the whole desk

Companion Animal Travel Desk service guide. The purpose of this section is to keep pet travel calm, safe, and easy to follow for guests and crew.

Start each case with a warm check-in, then review the animal's needs, carrier condition, and travel papers with care. Keep the tone simple and reassuring, and give only the guidance that helps the traveler move forward without stress. If a pet seems unsettled, pause the flow, offer steady support, and bring in the senior coordinator for a calm review.

For Merrowgate, <<FACT F011>> and then record the handoff in the desk log. Use the same careful approach for any pet that needs special space, and confirm that the carrier stays secure and well ventilated before the handoff. If a traveler asks for relief area directions at Thornwick, <<FACT F016>> and make sure the guest has clear walking guidance and a kind reminder about leash use. When a lounge question comes up for Thornwick, <<FACT F004>> and offer the traveler the easiest path to follow.

Keep all updates brief, accurate, and respectful. If the request falls outside normal desk service, move it up through the calm stepwise review, keep the traveler informed, and avoid passing along guesses. When in doubt, choose the safer option for the animal and the smoothest option for the guest.

For any unresolved concern, contact the senior coordinator or the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
